All remediation items below are selection-side and go to P2 and the named lanes queued at the w3 diversity consolidation - they are preconditions on the Stage-2 200-cut, not on Stage-1 completion.

remediation_items.requirement: All 680 free-text family_fingerprint strings must be back-mapped onto the controlled ~30-enum vocabulary mandated by the w3 decision before any mechanical slot-cap enforcement at the 200-cut (the field is currently 680/680 distinct - cap-unenforceable). Until the back-mapping lands, the cut applies the w3 genre-blind pooled caps (eval-subject pool <= 25% of the 200) and the cheap-predictor portfolio-freeze displacement rule using the judge flag lists, and Stage-2 must adopt ONE crowding instrument consistently (the 33-loose-regex vs 14-judge-fingerprint census divergence is an instrument artifact, not a factual conflict).

The named template-family sibling sets must receive forced best-of-family adjudication at the 200-cut - select best-of-family, never multiple undifferentiated siblings: at minimum J-051/J-076, E-029/E-054, B-060/B-065, F-019/F-023, N-061/N-070, C-003/C-004/C-057, the gen_e text-encoder-geometry block (E-034/E-047/E-050/E-051/E-052/E-053 + J-070), the gen_m pixels-per-batch/gradient-noise mechanics block (M-025/M-028/M-030/M-037/M-073/M-082/M-084/M-086), the ~13-15-member variance/protocol-artifact family, the gen_f sim-to-real cheap-statistics family, and the cross-shard provenance-forensics family.

431 records (176 w1 + 237 w2 + 15 w3 + 3 w4) lack numeric kill thresholds: P2 must down-rank them on falsifiability, and any such record must be numeric-retrofitted before it enters the 200-survivor list; soft w1/w2 records must not displace GATE-5-compliant records on topic novelty alone. Additionally the 8 gate1_qualitative_threshold records (7 gen_k + O-007, thresholds decisive but stated in words) owe a numeric-format retrofit. The GATE-5-compliant w3-w5 core (726 records) exceeds the 200 target 3.6x, so no soft record needs to advance by necessity.

287 gate4_deferred records lack a pinned public dataset+model for their cheap-kill experiment; per-record gate4_missing lists exist. Pinning is owed by the Stage-2 retrofit lane; a record entering the 200 without pinned assets carries this debt forward explicitly.

Auditor B asked the meta-judge to confirm or waive the dispatch-ordering slip: the w5 consolidator required the diversity_audit_w3 consolidation to merge before stage1_completion auditors dispatch, and completion auditor A pushed at 02:02:15Z, seven minutes before the diversity-w3 consolidator landed at 02:09:23Z (B and C pushed after it, at 02:11:45Z and 02:24:25Z). No re-audit required.
